content:
Horla E2 is good actually <:Ramona_tuff_:1441426630420467753> 

0 cost you will always play because it is free unless you were planning on not playing any cards that turn for whatever reason???? I guess then you don’t want to stance swap
2 cost, it will not matter what investment Horla is, be it E0 or AA, 2 cost is probably the first thing you will ever sell at shops and if you get into mob fights before any shop then oh man this 2 cost is seriously weighing me down its not like I want/generally have to end these mob fights quickly and in that timeframe holding one singular card massively holds me back

both 1 costs at E1 now gain Vuln and Weak application but only for that same turn… and E2 fixes that, you can now hold both 1 costs for your burst turn and when an enemy is about to hit you really hard so you have much greater control about when you apply these statuses

I don’t know if the E2 thing is just a funny bit or if people genuinely believe it is the worst E2 in the game (it is not by far) but yes E2 is actually really strong
